title: Iskaaptii Rifeensa qabu
intro: Mootummaa qilleensa, uumamtoota hin mul’anne, fi uumamtoota samii irratti ol’aantummaa kennameefiin bulfamu keessatti, miseensi xiqqaa fi ariifataa tokko tarree keessaa bade — mul’ata hiree saba fagoo tokkoo irra deebi’ee bocu qabate deebi’uu qofa. Odeeffataan ija cimaa qabu kun bakka wallaalummaan hidda gadi fageeffate dhugaa ifa baase. Ani Eenyu?
clues: Mana murtii namoonni, uumamtoonni hin mul’anne fi uumamtoonni samii bulchaa ogeessa tokkicha qilleensa sana ajaju tokkoof deebii itti kennan keessattin tajaajileera.
Yeroodhaaf barreeffama koo irraa kanan hin jirre yoo ta'u, sababa quubsaa yoon dhiheesse dheekkamsi bulchaa sanaa waadaa naaf galeera.
Ani uumama xiqqaa balali’u, ija qaraadhaan kan beekamu yoo ta’u, gosti koos fuula mul’ata irratti kallattiin maqaa moggaasuun kabajameera.
Yeroon deebi’u oduu lafa fagoo ummanni samii fi dachii uume jaamsee aduudhaaf sujuudu fide.
Dubartii mootummaa guddaa tokko bulchaa jirtu, teessoo guddaa irra teessee, kanaan dura dhugaa beekee hin beekne tokkon argadhe.
Ani nama mootummaa Saba' argadheen xalayaa waamichaa raajii-mootii qilleensa irratti ol'aantummaa kennameef baattee deemedha.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Bilqis mana murtii Suleemanitti dhiyaatee dhufe
Fara’oonii fi waraanni isaa galaana keessatti liqimfaman
outcome.answer: Bilqis mana murtii Suleemanitti dhiyaatee dhufe

arabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verse: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars. (27:27)
